title: Bananas (per lb)

adjustment.analysis: No known drivers for the target week: no events, no price change, and no promotion. The baseline already reflects recent trends (5.1% upward over 13 weeks) and seasonal patterns. Past Father's Day (week before) showed weak uplift (x1.05 median, noise-adjusted x1.0), indicating no reliable effect. No evidence of pantry loading or supply issues. The classical uplift model's x1.00 is well-supported by noise-adjusted history. No adjustment needed.
